verdict.rationale: The evidence says Expensify can automatically reimburse expenses in general. Nothing shows it pays employees abroad in their local currency or replaces a separate international payments process. SmartScan reading currency from receipts and multi-currency invoices are adjacent features and do not establish cross-border reimbursement.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can reimburse employees abroad in their local currency without running a separate international payments process
